subject.title: [Bug]: Codex app-server session wedges indefinitely after a 429 rate-limit burst — terminal-idle watchdog still gated by `activeAppServerTurnRequests > 0` (regression/incomplete fix of #82681)

question: Should this issue close on current-main source and test evidence now, or stay open until a release containing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102160 has live 429 verification?
rationale: The code path appears structurally addressed, but the latest issue comment asks for release-level live confirmation before cleanup close.

options.title: Keep For Release Proof
options.body: Leave this issue open until a shipped build with the run-lifecycle stack has redacted 429 traces proving shared-client recovery.

options.title: Close On Source Proof
options.body: Accept the current main implementation and tests as sufficient and close as implemented on main before live release evidence arrives.

options.title: Reopen Fix Design
options.body: If new traces show co-leased sessions still wedging past the completion-idle window, use this issue to drive a follow-up fix.

recommendation.title: Keep For Release Proof
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until a shipped build with the run-lifecycle stack has redacted 429 traces proving shared-client recovery.
